patterns.what_worked: Verified the AceDB storage shape before writing the migration (copyDefaults rawsets a fresh table per defaults table, initSection re-applies defaults to saved profiles but never overwrites present keys). That turned the risky part into an exact-match rule plus a theme_preset owner guard for the one colliding preset (Classic Retro = the old default bytes). The set_opts seam was the first settings-aware point in this lane's write scope; driving it for real in options_load_state (seed a profile, clear the flag, re-run) proved the call site without main.lua.
patterns.what_was_hard: The new range-bar semantics are split across two lanes: the defaults/options side is here, the module gate is weave_range.lua:210 (== true), so nil==ON for hunter is documented and getter-true but not yet true at the runtime gate. Also the copy now describes a horizontal bar the tree does not have yet - filed as a ship-order dependency rather than silently shipping a description of absent UI.
patterns.skill_gap: None blocking. Note for future lanes: config.lua loads AFTER option_tables.lua in every TOC, so a function defined there is only safe to call at runtime (set_opts), never at file scope.

escalation.recommendation: Orchestrator adds the tests/appearance_defaults_state.lua line to tests/run.sh (one-writer rule); bars-range-hunter lands the horizontal bar and the nil==ON hunter gate at weave_range.lua:210. Operator runs the bench report's 6 in-client checks.
